title: LIMBO — THE UNBAPTISED
author: Vergil Sparda
content:
The first circle holds no torment — only cold. The souls here were virtuous in life but arrived too early, before the age of hunters, before anyone knew the name Sparda.

Vergil passed through this circle three times. He noted it in his copy of the Qliphoth texts with a single line: "No different from the human world."

He was not wrong. The coldness here is the coldness of waiting for something that will not come. The demons who dwell in Limbo are the oldest — they have forgotten how to fight. They only watch.
